title: 美国造免关税：日本推新车，日产在华降15%靠什么补？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Could you explain to me maybe one or two big reasons each for the progress in Japan, the US, and China?
segments.zh: 您能否分别简要说明日本、美国和中国市场进展的一两个主要原因？

segments.en: And if I can sort of expand on that a little bit, I think you pointed to strong results during the first half as offering confidence but not comfort.
segments.zh: 如果我稍微展开一下，您提到上半年的强劲业绩带来了信心，但并非安逸。

segments.en: Right. So expand on that a little bit. Right, I think the first half, as you rightly described, we described earlier, it's giving us confidence
segments.zh: 对，请稍微展开一下。没错，正如您所说，我们之前也提到，上半年给了我们信心，

segments.en: that we can achieve our outlook. That's why we reaffirm the outlook for the year.
segments.zh: 相信我们能实现展望。这就是为什么我们重申了全年展望。

segments.en: But it's not giving us comfort because the environment is very harsh.
segments.zh: 但这并没有让我们感到安逸，因为环境非常严峻。

segments.en: So there's many things happening. Rome materials have increased significantly versus prior year.
segments.zh: 所以发生了很多事情。原材料成本较去年大幅上升。

segments.en: We don't see any change in the Middle East situation.
segments.zh: 我们没有看到中东局势有任何变化。

segments.en: So the environment remains very harsh. As for what is driving the performance in Japan and the US, I think the basics are just working.
segments.zh: 因此环境仍然非常严峻。至于日本和美国业绩的驱动因素，我认为基本策略正在奏效。

segments.en: Our strategy is the right one. In the US, particularly, we've been focusing on putting our marketing efforts on products that are built in the US, that are tariff free.
segments.zh: 我们的战略是正确的。特别是在美国，我们一直将营销努力集中在当地生产、免关税的产品上。

segments.en: And in return, these are very highly profitable products. In the case of Japan, we have launched a lot of new cars.
segments.zh: 反过来，这些产品利润非常高。在日本，我们推出了许多新车。

segments.en: We have refreshed our lineup. And we are focusing on doing the basics right.
segments.zh: 我们更新了产品阵容，并专注于做好基础工作。

segments.en: Now for China, China is a very complicated environment.
segments.zh: 现在来看中国，中国是一个复杂的环境。

segments.en: As we have seen in the first half, the TIB dropped around 22%.
segments.zh: 正如我们在上半年所见，TIB下降了约22%。

segments.en: In our case, in the first half, our volumes dropped by 15%.
segments.zh: 就我们而言，上半年销量下降了15%。

segments.en: It accelerated more in the last three months.
segments.zh: 过去三个月下降速度加快。
